titleBack: They Will Be Lost And Confused

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you CONTROL Theed Palace Throne Room WITH Amidala there (controlsWith: you control the location and Amidala is spotted there, spotting includes excluded-from-battle).

children.req: CONTROL-WITH: owner controls location with actor there

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if OPPONENT controls Theed Palace Throne Room (plain control; Amidala irrelevant).

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is CONTROL + WITH-actor: GameConditions.controlsWith - owner must control Theed Palace Throne Room AND Amidala must be there. Not occupy, not presence-only.
Flip-to-front is opponent plain CONTROL of the same site - so merely losing your own control does NOT flip back; opponent must take control.
No place-out-of-play condition on either side.

Back Force-loss engine also keys off controlsWith semantics: Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.or(Filters.Amidala, Filters.Panaka)) applied per battleground site (Card14_052_BACK.java:93,121).
typedIdentities: Filters.Theed_Palace_Throne_Room (setup deploy; flip gate location both directions)
Filters.Amidala (persona; flip actor and back drain-loss actor), Filters.Panaka (persona; back drain-loss actor only)
Filters.interior_Naboo_site (front: your characters may not deploy there)

Deploy ban (remainder of game): Filters.and(Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.Jedi), Filters.alien, Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.vehicle), Filters.Republic_character, Filters.and(Icon.REPUBLIC, Filters.starship))))
Filters.Your_Destiny (suspended for remainder of game), Filters.Vengeance_Of_The_Dark_Prince (no Force loss from it)
Back: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Icon.REPUBLIC, Filters.starship) power +2; Filters.and(Icon.TRADE_FEDERATION, Filters.starship) immunity to attrition canceled
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Theed Palace Throne Room (Card14_052.java:54), Theed Palace Hallway (Card14_052.java:61), Theed Palace Courtyard (Card14_052.java:68).
No objective-granted pulls/tutors after setup on either side.
FRONT: once per turn, may activate 1 Force (Card14_052.java:105-123) - the only Force-economy relief while front-side deploy restrictions apply.
otherObligations: FOR REMAINDER OF GAME (granted after deployment completes, survive flips, Card14_052.java:78-95): may not deploy cards with ability except [Episode I] Jedi, aliens, [Episode I] vehicles, Republic characters, and [Republic] starships; may not deploy cards with ability using Dejarik rules; Your Destiny is suspended; you lose no Force to Vengeance Of The Dark Prince.

FRONT ONLY: your characters may not deploy to interior Naboo sites (Card14_052.java:100) - directly constrains how Amidala can reach the Throne Room (an interior site): she must MOVE there, not deploy there.

BACK: you lose no more than 2 Force to any Force drain (Card14_052_BACK.java:53); your [Republic] starships power +2 (54); [Trade Federation] starships' immunity to attrition canceled (55); may pay 1 Force to cancel an opponent battle destiny > 3 (66-79); once during your control phase opponent loses 2 Force per battleground site you control with Amidala or Panaka - offered as a top-level action (92-105) and FORCED as a required trigger at end of your control phase if unused (119-133).

Rando obligations: front - walk Amidala into the Throne Room and take control; back - hold Throne Room control against opponent, and spread Amidala/Panaka across controlled battleground sites for the recurring 2-Force-loss engine.
seedMismatches: Seed (Objective_Playbook_Facts_2026-07-08.json entry 14_52) cites sourceEvidence 'front Java getGameTextWhileActiveInPlay' / 'back Java getGameTextWhileActiveInPlay' for both flip laws; the flip triggers actually live in getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers on both sides. Relations and filters in the seed are otherwise correct.

profileGaps: flipGateSite is null; true flip gate location both directions is Theed Palace Throne Room (Filters.Theed_Palace_Throne_Room, present only as an unlabeled objectiveNamedLocations entry).
keyCharacterFilter is null; true flip actor is Filters.Amidala (and Filters.Panaka for the back Force-loss engine).
objectiveNamedLocations entries all have null labels and empty titleFragments/blueprintIds - filter strings only; nothing resolves to concrete card ids.
No representation that your characters cannot DEPLOY to interior Naboo sites while front-side (Amidala must move in), nor of the flip-back condition (opponent controls Throne Room).
